meta.frame_selection: scene_gt_info.px_count_visib >= 1200; evenly spaced over the sequence; 20 attempts per object; selection never looks at K or at the estimator output
meta.metric_mesh: models/ (byte-identical to the LINEMOD meshes); models_eval is the secondary adds_eval_m column
meta.note: GT-pose correspondences: a controlled estimator experiment on real cost functions, not a detector; no front-end and no accuracy claim against published pipelines.

comparison_linemod.note: Cited, not recomputed. LINEMOD ADD-S AUC was not computed in that file, so no LINEMOD AUC is quoted here.

mesh_identity.note: models/ (not models_eval/) is byte-identical to the LINEMOD mesh used by results/pose_error.json; models_eval is a coarser BOP mesh and is reported only as the secondary adds_eval_m column.

mode_enumeration_2x_starts.note: find_modes re-run with 2x starts on the identical reduced cost; K and hard argmin are compared with the primary 384-start run.
